criteria.description: Peripheral base addresses, register offsets, bitmask operations, and clock-gate enable sequences match the official chip TRM and vendor Errata workarounds; cite register definition lines.

Adhere to safety-critical standards (MISRA-C:2012 / AUTOSAR C++): bounded loop counters, no unbounded recursion, no dynamic heap allocation after init, and explicit fixed-width integers (uint32_t, etc.); cite loop headers and type definitions.

Shared resources between ISRs and thread context protected with volatile declarations, memory barriers, or critical section primitives; ISR execution path remains non-blocking; cite interrupt handlers and lock blocks.
Verify stack depth budgets, buffer boundary guards against overflow, and DMA cache coherency flush/invalidate before/after hardware transfers; cite buffer sizes and cache clean invocations.
